en.headline: Customs seize HK$68 million in suspected counterfeit goods in Double 11 operation
en.dek: Officers cracked 39 cases and arrested two people after intercepting about 120,000 items bound mainly for the Americas and the Middle East.
body: Hong Kong Customs said on Monday it had seized about 120,000 suspected counterfeit items with an estimated market value of HK$68 million during a month-long operation targeting the Double 11 shopping period.

The operation, codenamed Double Nunchaku and running from 23 October to 13 November, uncovered 39 cases. Most of the goods, including watches, phones, shoes, clothing and electronic products, were intended for transshipment overseas, mainly to the Americas and the Middle East.

Two people, a 68-year-old male warehouse worker and a 39-year-old female director, were arrested after officers raided an online store in Kwai Chung. Customs reminded the public to buy from reputable shops and websites and to report suspected infringements.

zh.headline: 海關「雙十一」行動檢值6800萬元冒牌貨 拘兩人
zh.dek: 海關破獲39宗案件，檢獲約12萬件懷疑冒牌物品，主要準備轉運至美洲及中東地區。
body: 香港海關周一表示，在針對「雙十一」購物節的為期一個月行動中，檢獲約12萬件懷疑冒牌物品，估計市值約6800萬元，並拘捕兩人。
代號「雙截棍」的行動由10月23日至11月13日進行，一共偵破39宗案件。大部分貨品包括手錶、手提電話、鞋履、服飾及電子產品，準備經香港轉運至海外，主要是美洲和中東地區。
海關在葵涌突擊搜查一間網店後，拘捕一名68歲男倉務員及一名39歲女董事。海關呼籲市民光顧信譽良好的店舖及網站，如發現懷疑侵權活動可向海關舉報。
